status: PROVISIONAL — pending SME validation. Field estimates only; not an authoritative metric score.
source: Derived/structured from the Statutory Biodiversity Metric — Condition Assessments (23.07.24), Natural England/Defra, Open Government Licence v3.0 (https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/statutory-biodiversity-metric-tools-and-guides).
positioning: Supplemental capture of rapid by-eye condition calls as desk evidence. Not a replacement for quadrat measurement, mapping, or the statutory metric calculator.

rules.Good: passes 6 or 7 criteria AND passes essential criterion A
rules.Moderate: passes 4 or 5 criteria AND passes essential criterion A
rules.Poor: passes 3 or fewer; OR passes 4-6 but fails essential criterion A

criteria.label: 6-8 vascular plant species per m2, including at least 2 forbs
Varied sward height (>=20% under 7cm and >=20% over 7cm)
Scrub less than 20% of total grassland area
Physical damage in less than 5% of area
Absence of invasive non-native species (Schedule 9, WCA 1981)

habitats.label: Native hedgerow (without trees)

rules.Good: no more than 2 failures total AND no more than 1 failure in any functional group
rules.Moderate: no more than 4 failures total AND does not fail both attributes in more than one functional group
rules.Poor: more than 4 failures total; OR fails both attributes in more than one functional group

criteria.label: Basal gap: gap between ground and canopy base <0.5m for >90% of length
Canopy continuity: gaps <10% of length and no canopy gap >5m
Undisturbed ground: >=1m width of perennial herbaceous vegetation for >90% of length
Nutrient enrichment: enrichment-indicator species <20% cover of undisturbed ground
Invasive/neophyte species: >90% of hedgerow and ground free of them (Schedule 9, WCA)
Current damage: >90% free of damage from human activities

habitats.notes: With-trees variant adds functional group E (E1 tree class, E2 tree health) and uses higher Moderate failure thresholds — out of POC scope.
